psychological_meaning: Pigment Indigo is often associated with intuition, perception, and spirituality. It can promote deep concentration during introspection and meditation, and it has a calming effect, promoting inner peace and clarity. This color symbolizes wisdom, dignity, and independence, and can also represent the ending of a phase in life.
